How I was guided through the journey of research, and the task design along with the high expectations of the instructor were the urging element for me to develop myself. Since I believe in the external factors as driving force for my personal development as a researcher, I found this class' very challenging nature extremely fruitful. The instructor's positive reinforcements were really inspiring and motivating at certain times. I find pride in evident improvement in myself compared to the stage I was at in the beginning of the semester.

On the other hand, even though it was acknowledged and verbally stated that errors we make are the natural process of learning through this journey, there were times the class experienced shame and blame due to certain errors. I agree that certain mistakes are not tolerable, especially in an MA program. However, it was demotivating for me to witness a colleague receiving harsh feedback.

Overall, this course was a very fruitful journey thanks to the on point, comprehensive feedback, tireless guidance, and very motivating positive reinforcement practices of my instructor. How the class is designed and scheduled, allowing room for peer-feedback, also made it possible for me to connect and learn a lot from my colleagues.

The course was much more interesting than I thought it would be. The topics were engaging because I think all of us could relate to some parts of them and there was a lot of room to share our own experiences. The course has changed how I view organizations and made me realize how limited my perceptions were. It also gave me hope in a way. Throughout the course, I felt that I had lost my will and enthusiasm about changing something, or even imagining it. Now I know that I can be a part of that change and I have so many plans already.

instructor:
Taking EFL Methodology 1 with Professor Tijen has been an incredibly enriching experience. One of her strongest qualities is her ability to explain complex concepts in language teaching with clarity and precision. She excels at bridging the gap between theory and practice, making the material not only understandable but also highly relevant to real-world teaching scenarios.

Professor Tijen’s dedication to her students is remarkable. She creates a welcoming and supportive environment where every student feels encouraged to participate and ask questions. Her approachability and willingness to provide additional guidance, whether through in-depth discussions or extra resources, demonstrate her genuine commitment to her students’ success.

The way she incorporates a variety of teaching methods into her lessons makes the class engaging and thought-provoking. Whether through interactive activities, case studies, or meaningful discussions, she ensures that students are not just passive learners but active participants in the process. Her ability to encourage critical thinking and reflection on effective teaching practices has been particularly impactful.

Professor Tijen is an inspiring educator whose passion for teaching is evident in every class. Her guidance and expertise have left a lasting impact, and I would highly recommend her class to anyone looking to deepen their understanding of EFL methodology.
course:
The EFL Methodology 1 course offers a well-rounded and insightful introduction to the principles and practices of English language teaching. One of its strongest aspects is its focus on bridging theory and practice, allowing students to not only understand foundational methodologies but also to see how they can be applied in real-world teaching scenarios. The course content is comprehensive, covering a variety of key topics that are essential for both novice and experienced teachers. This breadth ensures that students gain a solid understanding of different approaches to language teaching.

Another strength of the course is its emphasis on critical thinking and reflection. Students are encouraged to evaluate the effectiveness of various teaching methods and adapt them to diverse classroom settings, which fosters a deeper understanding of the subject matter. The interactive nature of the course, including discussions and practical activities, adds to its overall engagement and effectiveness.

Overall, EFL Methodology 1 is a thoughtfully designed course that equips students with essential tools and perspectives for teaching English as a foreign language.
